topics.name: World Models and Vision-Language-Action Robotics
topics.summary: Embodied policies combine visual-language instruction with compact predictive state, action quantization, and decoupled video-action experts. These representations reduce inference burden while preserving physical cues, affordances, and transfer to new tasks.

topics.name: Robot Manipulation Learning
topics.summary: Manipulation learners use target-conditioned affordances, contact-aware sensing, tactile prediction, kinematic priors, and real-robot demonstrations. The recurring gains concern generalization to articulated objects, novel scenes, and scarce-data contact interactions.

topics.name: Model-Based and Robust Robot Control
topics.summary: Physics-reduced models, differentiable constraint layers, robust synthesis, and risk-aware grasp or continuum-arm control encode feasibility and uncertainty directly. Evaluations report more stable trajectories and better behavior under friction, pressure, disturbances, and model mismatch.

topics.name: Motion Planning and Autonomous Navigation
topics.summary: Aerial mapping, orbital maneuvering, underwater navigation, and obstacle-aware manipulation use task-conditioned policies, hybrid search, and continual adaptation. These methods reduce replanning or real-world experience while maintaining feasible motion in changing environments.

topics.name: Legged Locomotion Learning
topics.summary: Reinforcement learning for legged robots benefits from wrench-guided exploration and reusable motion codebooks. The resulting skills support terrain-robust acquisition and downstream humanoid or locomotion tasks with more structured action representations.

topics.name: Adaptive and Safe Reinforcement Learning
topics.summary: Successor representations enable rapid policy updates when safety costs change, while discrepancy control stabilizes language-model policy training across precision regimes. Both approaches target reliable exploration and adaptation without rebuilding the full learner.

topics.name: Neural and Gaze Decoding
topics.summary: Generative gaze descriptions and neural decoders extend human-signal interfaces beyond fixed labels or short calibration sessions. Attention models, consistency training, and drift-aware adaptation improve intent, force, and kinematic decoding across users and changing signals.

topics.name: Multimodal Visual Grounding and Reasoning
topics.summary: Question-conditioned fusion, spatial token supervision, and fine-grained visual tests examine whether multimodal models use the right image evidence. Across grounding, VQA, and diagram tasks, targeted visual selection improves alignment while revealing persistent basic-perception failures.

topics.name: Efficient and Robust Multimodal Vision
topics.summary: Training-free token selection, global-context reweighting, cross-modal collaboration, and reliability estimates make visual models less costly and less sensitive to missing or contaminated inputs. The methods preserve useful detail while reducing retraining and deployment overhead.

topics.name: Vision Foundation Model Adaptation
topics.summary: Synthetic identity data, prompt-first expert training, and visual feedback adapt foundation models with limited parameters or examples. Recognition and multimodal generation experiments show improved transfer, compatibility, and task performance after targeted updates.

topics.name: Video Understanding and Temporal Segmentation
topics.summary: Marine event understanding, referring segmentation, sparse-frame reasoning, test-time adaptation, and boundary-aware sampling address long or unreliable video evidence. Tool-assisted verification and lightweight adapters improve temporal localization across changing domains.

topics.name: Visual Generation, Diffusion, and Video Control
topics.summary: Diffusion and autoregressive systems improve generation speed, diversity, conditioning, and camera or event control through sparse attention, distillation, trajectory design, and geometric cues. Applications span images, video, avatars, 3D views, and multimodal reconstruction.

topics.name: Digital Humans and Identity-Preserving Face Synthesis
topics.summary: Audio-visual human generation and diffusion-based face synthesis compress expressive motion or identity evidence into manageable conditioning. Results emphasize synchronized speech, temporal continuity, parent-identity balance, and the realism-identity tradeoff relevant to biometric applications.

topics.name: 3D Perception, Localization, and Mapping
topics.summary: Point-cloud explanations, BEV fusion, transparent-surface depth, human meshes, visual localization, structured-light reconstruction, and source-fused mapping address incomplete geometry and difficult scenes. The shared emphasis is accurate spatial recovery with practical correspondence or validation.

topics.name: Geometric Deep Learning and Compact 3D Representations
topics.summary: Geometric regularization, hierarchical local decoding, and structure-aware mesh representations preserve intrinsic shape while reducing storage or improving downstream prediction. Experiments cover denoising, rate-distortion, deformation, correspondence, and expressive asset generation.

topics.name: Image Restoration and Low-Level Vision
topics.summary: Frequency-aware perception, multiscale refinement, self-supervised denoising, and reference-driven inpainting recover fine structure under noise, low light, missing pixels, or limited labels. Compact models are evaluated on recognition, target detection, and restoration workloads.

topics.name: Earth Observation and Remote Sensing
topics.summary: SAR time series, infrared imagery, solar-structure masks, and large-area Earth-observation products require scalable preprocessing, multiscale segmentation, uncertainty handling, and independent validation. The studies show how pipeline choices affect scientific and mapping reliability.

topics.name: Biomedical Imaging and Clinical Segmentation
topics.summary: Clinical vision systems combine user contours, superpixel optimization, spatial biological priors, spectral reconstruction, foundation-model transfer, active learning, and test-time adaptation. Applications include lesions, mammography, MRI, retinal vessels, ultrasound, and multispectral anomaly detection.

topics.name: Speech, Audio, and Waveform Analysis
topics.summary: Audio deepfake detection, multilingual speech recognition, emotion estimation, clinical acoustics, ECG intervals, and neutron resonances use convolutional, expert, multimodal, or subgroup-aware models. Results highlight cross-dataset robustness and the limits of aggregate accuracy under atypical signals.

topics.name: Recommendation Modeling and Search Ranking
topics.summary: Recommendation and search systems use temporal user summaries, spectral-aware attention, graph structure, hierarchical identifiers, ordinal relevance, and shared recall-ranking context. Offline and online results connect better ranking to preference drift, sparse feedback, and explicit navigation structure.

topics.name: Personalized and Generative Recommendation Systems
topics.summary: Generative policies, multimodal item graphs, latent interest paths, value-sensitive routing, and co-trained caches address cold starts, freshness, serving cost, and preference diversity. The recurring finding is that representation and serving choices materially affect recommendation coverage.

topics.name: Social Media Manipulation and Computational Social Science
topics.summary: Longitudinal platform data, agent-based simulations, survey-grounded personas, and network diffusion experiments study bots, misinformation, incentives, self-censorship, and competing narratives. Findings connect individual perceptions and platform dynamics to broader influence outcomes.

topics.name: Human-Centered AI and Conversational Effects
topics.summary: Accessibility tools, therapist-facing reminiscence support, extended-reality interfaces, muscle stimulation, and conversational-agent studies adapt systems to cognitive or emotional needs. User evaluations emphasize agency, reduced setup burden, participation, and risks of dependency or vulnerability amplification.

topics.name: Long-Context Language Models and Agent Architecture
topics.summary: Agent platforms, addressable memories, cache planning, grouped attention, multilingual tokenization, and parallel decoding reduce context and serving costs. The systems favor modular skills, selective access to prior observations, and efficient execution over monolithic prompts.

topics.name: Agent Safety, Provenance, and Verification
topics.summary: Memory attribution, belief revision, provenance tracking, transactional tool use, information-flow controls, evidence graphs, and external outcome checks constrain agent actions. These methods reduce stale-memory errors, unsafe repairs, prompt-driven exfiltration, and unsupported claims.

topics.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Active Search
topics.summary: Retrieval routing, teacher-guided search, evidence memory, reuse-aware evaluation, and conjunctive coverage tests treat lookup as a decision process rather than simple similarity matching. Utility estimates expose when retrieval helps, harms, or exceeds the available budget.

topics.name: Document Question Answering and Evidence Attribution
topics.summary: Legal, historical, and visual-document systems combine retrieval, OCR correction, graph queries, semantic anchors, cropping, and source quotation. The methods improve answers over changing or noisy records while making the supporting evidence easier to locate and audit.

topics.name: Knowledge Graphs and Provenance-Aware Retrieval
topics.summary: Language models are coupled to schema-guided graph construction, relation normalization, corroboration, and versioned review across mathematical, regulatory, cyber, scientific, and clinical sources. Graph retrieval improves traceability and helps expose unsupported alternatives or claims.

topics.name: Schema-Constrained NLP and Data Workflows
topics.summary: Schema validation, quality rules, relational consistency checks, structured simulation intermediates, clinical response repair, and spatial metadata views turn ambiguous language or heterogeneous data into inspectable outputs. The recurring benefit is improved interoperability and easier review.

topics.name: Scientific and Clinical LLM Workflows
topics.summary: Grounded agents assist biology screening, flood forecasting, clinical evidence synthesis, EEG analysis, quantum sensing, scientific model refinement, and ECG prediction. Retrieval, typed tools, fixed evaluation contracts, and deterministic safeguards keep language-model flexibility separate from consequential execution.

topics.name: Interactive Web and Coding Agents
topics.summary: GUI transition models, pre- and post-action evidence checks, repository maps, lexical retrieval, embeddings, and uncertainty-aware file search improve interactive and code-generation workflows. The studies show that state-aware context selection enables more localized recovery and repair.

topics.name: LLM Alignment, Behavior, and Post-Training
topics.summary: Prompt interventions, runtime social controls, demonstration-guided policies, precision-aware reinforcement learning, pretraining-slice analysis, and consensus-based preference data examine how behavior changes after or around training. Results emphasize sensitivity to data, model generation, and decoding conditions.

topics.name: LLM Safety and Adversarial Robustness
topics.summary: Tool-call attacks, jailbreaks, image degradation, quantization, distributed payloads, feature perturbations, and community-specific harmful content expose weaknesses missed by clean benchmarks. The studies favor context-sensitive defenses, early detection, and diagnostics tied to actual failure modes.

topics.name: Faithfulness, Interpretability, and Reasoning in Language Models
topics.summary: Synthetic tasks, activation interventions, hidden-state spectra, feature-effect tests, explanation studies, multilingual verification, and pragmatic reasoning probes evaluate whether outputs reflect appropriate internal evidence. Larger models often route concepts more cleanly, but fluent answers can still rely on shortcuts.

topics.name: AI Assurance, Governance, and Evaluation
topics.summary: Execution-state reporting, independent acceptance tests, ethical constraints, guideline-based attribution, OCR audits, cost-normalized benchmarks, and prospective forecasting evaluations make safety or capability claims harder to game. These methods pair performance with evidence, process, and operational conditions.

topics.name: Calibrated and Uncertainty-Aware AI
topics.summary: Dataset-identity controls, hierarchical conformal rules, uncertainty decomposition, selective deferral, value-aware routing, biometric calibration, and V2X adaptation address heterogeneous or shifted deployments. The common goal is regime-aware monitoring beyond aggregate accuracy.

topics.name: Statistical Learning Theory and High-Dimensional Inference
topics.summary: Streaming PCA, delayed generalization, debiased estimation, Bayesian sparsity, proxy outcomes, shape restrictions, and transfer clustering provide thresholds or guarantees for structured high-dimensional data. The analyses connect optimization, nuisance adjustment, alignment, and sample complexity to reliable inference.

topics.name: Distributional Learning and Optimal Transport
topics.summary: Kernel discrepancy bounds, distribution embeddings, Sinkhorn dynamics, generative coupling, and adversarial transport study how probability measures can be compared or constrained. Results connect contraction, lower bounds, and sample-based transport to robustness and computational efficiency.

topics.name: Unsupervised Clustering, Mixtures, and Factorization
topics.summary: Micro-cluster compression, Bayesian mixtures, trace-based nonnegative factorization, graph connectivity, posterior-simplex geometry, and unlabeled classification recover latent structure without dense pairwise computation or direct labels. Tradeoffs involve memory, identifiability, speed, and approximation error.

topics.name: Scientific Machine Learning for PDEs and Physical Simulation
topics.summary: Operator learning, reduced-order models, neural surrogates, physics residuals, diffusion corrections, and uncertainty-weighted reconstruction accelerate PDE and physical simulation while retaining governing structure. Validation spans long-horizon error, convergence, gradients, memory, and physical plausibility.

topics.name: Temporal Dynamics and Structured Forecasting
topics.summary: Quantum observables, oscillator-inspired reservoirs, bidirectional trajectory inpainting, and explicit memory dynamics model temporal structure directly. Benchmark results show benefits for multivariate forecasting, delayed tasks, missing observations, and complex dynamical systems.

topics.name: Chemical and Materials Discovery
topics.summary: Conditional diffusion, physics-guided latent geometry, and contrastive molecular graphs connect generative proposals or learned representations to catalyst structure, porous transport, and ADMET properties. The methods bring physical or biological constraints closer to candidate generation and screening.

topics.name: Financial Machine Learning and Reliable Analysis
topics.summary: Multi-alpha ranking, LLM-derived sentiment, uncertainty calibration, selective abstention, and evidence auditing target noisy markets and judgment-heavy financial decisions. Findings favor diversified signals and explicit confidence over unsupported point predictions.

topics.name: Transportation Forecasting and Autonomous Fleets
topics.summary: Traffic volumes, crash hotspots, dynamic pricing, railway recovery, federated mobility forecasting, congestion rerouting, fleet rebalancing, and distributed inspection auctions address changing demand and disruptions. Spatial structure and decentralized adaptation improve service efficiency and resilience.

topics.name: Edge, Wireless, and Energy-Efficient Computing
topics.summary: Streaming data admission, aerial communications, virtualized radio systems, underwater stations, low-bit inference, and integer-compatible operators optimize service under memory, power, bandwidth, or compute limits. The methods combine learned cost models with scheduling or hardware-aware execution.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Learning and Machine Unlearning
topics.summary: Unlearning updates, topological diagnostics, stylometric masking, private similarity release, homomorphic aggregation, and federated genomic learning examine how useful representations can coexist with deletion or confidentiality. The papers expose residual structure and quantify utility-privacy distortion.

topics.name: Low-Resource Language Technology and Stylometry
topics.summary: Translation, ancient-text retrieval, compact language modeling, authorship obfuscation, and textual attribute inference rely on morphology-aware preparation, historical normalization, lexical alteration, and domain adaptation. Results improve transfer under scarce data while showing that stylistic privacy signals remain exploitable.

topics.name: Open Multi-Agent Systems
topics.summary: Evolutionary constitutions, pointer or graph policies, changing membership, and shifting task sets study cooperation and generalization when agent populations are not fixed. The analyses focus on incentives, responsibility reassignment, and maintaining useful coordination under open-system dynamics.

topics.name: Large Language Models for Neuroscience and Memory Research
topics.summary: Language models are used both as structured hypothesis generators and as comparison systems for memory representation, retrieval, updating, and intervention. Connectome-informed literature synthesis produces testable circuit ideas, while brain-model comparisons emphasize functional parallels rather than anatomical identity.
